original_test_intent: Thermally qualify BlueField-3 by exercising the specified Arm, memory, acceleration, PCIe and network SerDes subsystems while verifying temperatures, throttling, errors and service stability.
original_method: Pin BF3 thermal module/config; inventory DPU serial/BDF, firmware/mode/services and cooling; define per-subsystem workloads, concurrency, duration and sensor/power/error limits; drain traffic; run with host/DPU telemetry and hard aborts; restore services and confirm DPU/host health.
manual_activity: DPU/thermal owner selects workloads and thresholds and coordinates service drain; operator owns thermal abort and DPU recovery.
safety_requirements: Abort on limit, service, SerDes, link or management anomaly
No guessed module or log clearing
agent_execution_scope: Run one bounded BF3 thermal suite
Collect component telemetry/results and restore services
